violations.text: Dishes and utensils were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Hand washing sink was cleared at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

The door to the outside, located in the main entrance to the right, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2026
Strawberries, whipped cream, and drinks were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
The soft serve machine and ice cream scoop dipper well were observed non-operational and in poor repair. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain test strips. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

The floor behind units in the ice cream area have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the ware washing area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. A gas-powered motorcycle was observed next to the counter in the retail area. Per owner, motorcycle will be taken out of establishment tomorrow morning. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026
The ceiling in the ware washing area is in poor repair, observed missing tile. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the ware washing area. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/13/2024
The hand-washing sink in the ware washing area was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/13/2024
The hand-washing sink in the ware washing area and restroom were lacking signage. New Violation. Correct By: 12/13/2024

Raw animal foods (shelled eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (milk) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/13/2024

The door to the outside, located at both front entrances, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 12/27/2024
Drinks were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 12/13/2024
Establishment is lacking air drying racks. Cleaned and SANITIZED, EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS shall be air dried. PIC to install racks for air drying. New Violation. Correct By: 12/27/2024
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 12/27/2024
The ceiling in the ware washing area is in poor repair, observed missing tile. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/27/2024

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the retail area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/27/2024
